text: Architecture and implementation are now unified: Ravel is the sole dense array owner; image4s Sampled is the sole dense sampled-image value; ScalaFIM NeuroVol/NeuroVec are zero-runtime opaque aliases; sparse series is support plus rank-2 Ravel; narr/NArray is absent. Cross-platform correctness and same-run performance gates pass. The epic remains open solely for immutable image4s/Ravel dependency coordinates and the published-consumer rerun tracked in ScalaFIM bd-01KYQA1RNB49PDNAMBCKMMYVPP and this store bd-01KYNR86DV1M5CZFR0P3K7J4YN.
